primary_title: The P2Y2 nucleotide receptor requires interaction with alpha v integrins to access and activate G12
decision_basis: Integrin-dependent association and dominant-negative validation support the bounded P2Y2-to-G alpha-12 edge.
limitations_preserved: Preserve P2Y2 RGD-integrin, UTP and G alpha-12 context; no universal coupling, SCI or terminal-TF expansion.

primary_title: Regulation of adenylyl cyclase type V/VI in smooth muscle: interplay of inhibitory G protein and Ca2+ influx
decision_basis: PTX-sensitive UTP/P2Y2 inhibition of adenylyl cyclase supports a bounded G alpha-i3 coupling edge in gastric smooth muscle.
limitations_preserved: Preserve rat gastric smooth-muscle, UTP and PTX context; no purified binary binding, universal physiology, SCI or terminal-TF expansion.

primary_title: Pharmacological characterization of the human P2Y13 receptor; Identification of a novel human ADP receptor coupled to Gi
decision_basis: Recombinant human P2Y13 assays support a G alpha-16/GNA15-dependent IP3 branch distinct from aggregate Gi representation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve recombinant human receptor, G alpha-16/GNA15 coexpression and agonist concentration context; no universal native-cell route, high-concentration Gs expansion, SCI or terminal-TF claim.
